name: Aram
overview: Aram is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Kemuel, as recorded in Genesis 22:21. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Aram appears once in the biblical record without an explicit meaning or divine origin noted. It is presented simply as a proper name in Genesis 22:21.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Aram as the son of Kemuel, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections are documented in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Aram's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the patriarchal narratives, serving to trace the lineage connected to the broader biblical story.
